verdict.comment: It's tempting to side with one of the 3yos and BANKSMAN went very close last time. He can land a first success.

comments.amal: Long time since her sole win and she's easily opposed on the balance of her form
comments.banksman: Market support went down the tubes two starts ago; last time was much better; interesting
comments.camdenflyer: Not great the last twice but may build on her recent comeback; stays the trip on pedigree
comments.dashpower: Three years since his last turf start but was in good form for this yard in the winter
comments.eagerpuccini: Nothing to show for four AW starts (7f/1m); gelding and cheekpieces may help though
comments.elzour: Nothing to show for four starts but this is much easier and blinkers go on; market check
comments.glastonbury: Sole win came over C&D in cheekpieces; below that form since and now tried in blinkers
comments.ladyshinto: Modest form in five starts (6f/7f); new trip needs to spark plenty of improvement
comments.lambournghini: Second when stepped up to 1m and moved into handicaps last time; may be more to come
comments.perfectruby: Awarded a race at Lingfield (blinkers) in January; respected on classified debut
comments.primrosemaid: Much better last time when third in a C&D handicap; possibilities if she can build on that
comments.werenotreallyhere: Dead-heated at Brighton last time and that's the best recent form on offer; big player

races.raceComment: werenotreallyhere is confidently preferred with a score of 50.8%, holding clear edges in better ratings and more proven at trip and stronger recent form and more progressive over primrosemaid. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter, potentially favoring the selection's run style. Key attributes include optimal distance, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Monkmoor Pip ran well on his stable debut but CLOUDSIDE ROCK shaped well when third here last time and is preferred.

comments.cloudsiderock: Posted a good effort when third over 1m4f here 21 days ago; unexposed and has solid claims
comments.devizes: Beaten 59l on turf when back from break; returns to AW with a headgear switch
comments.lawnranger: 10yo whose sole AW win came in 2017; needs to have left his reappearance effort behind
comments.monkmoorpip: Respectable fifth on stable debut and first run for 398 days; entitled to come on for it
comments.mybad: Well beaten all four starts (1m-9.5f), including on handicap debut latest; new trip
comments.neddiesboy: Sole win came at Dundalk last February; failed to beat a rival in three starts for yard.
comments.pabloprince: C&D winner in September off a 2lb lower mark; claims if ready to go back from break
comments.sceptic: Three respectable efforts since Wolverhampton win in March; visor replaces cheekpieces
comments.threeyorkshiremen: 2-24 on Flat; best race for a while at Wolverhampton last month; now needs to build on it.
comments.uzincso: Six-time course winner over 1m; returns from 149 days off on a career-low mark
comments.wadacregiorgio: 0-4; went off too hard on handicap/seasonal debut at Carlisle 12 days ago; returns to AW.
comments.wyldbill: Well beaten in five starts (Flat/hurdles); steps up in trip with blinkers added

races.raceComment: pabloprince is marginally preferred with a score of 45.9%, holding clear edges in better ratings over devizes. Won 1 of last 6 starts, though returning from absence and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.

verdict.comment: The in-form IGNAC LAMAR has the assistance of Simon Walker and can follow up last month's C&D win. The Cola Brasil is feared.

comments.angelofthebay: Fair third at Carlisle recently but now 0-15 and the drop back to 6f isn't an obvious plus
comments.berniethebear: Patchy record on turf, on which he's 0-14, and is without a win since December 2023
comments.coconutbay: Went close at Musselburgh last month; could be thereabouts; declared Catterick yesterday
comments.ignaclamar: Won over C&D last month and he remains well treated on his AW form; strong claims
comments.newyorkstateofmind: Below par the last twice (including here) but shouldn't be ruled out at a track he likes
comments.superiorcouncil: 18-race maiden but each-way shout on the pick of last season's Irish form
comments.thecolabrasil: Signs of promise this spring for new (Newmarket) yard; this stiff 6f should suit
comments.tommytwohoots: Won in good style at Nottingham last October on heavy; plenty of rain would aid his cause

races.raceComment: ignaclamar is marginally preferred with a score of 49.7%, holding clear edges in more proven at trip and stronger recent form and superior course form over coconutbay. Won 2 of last 6 starts. Going is a significant concern - yet to win on Good ground from 8 attempts. Key attributes include excellent form and optimal distance, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.

verdict.comment: The in-form filly FRENCH HAVEN is unexposed and taken to win again.

comments.ayrpoet: Competitive over C&D on his last two starts and that is again likely to be the case.
comments.bellasio: Best handicap effort yet when second over C&D latest; same mark; should be involved.
comments.ciscodisco: Multiple winner at up to 1m; inconsistent either side of a close second (1m) last October.
comments.crownthorpe: Turf form has tailed off in the past two years; cheekpieces now accompanied by tongue-tie.
comments.falaiseblanc: Glimpses of ability but still has it to prove back on turf after being well beaten on AW.
comments.frenchhaven: 1m winner who bettered that in defeat (8.5f, good) latest; respected from the same mark.
comments.gaelicgladiator: Well beaten on his return from a break; interesting if supported on handicap debut.
comments.keatshouse: Has shown minor ability but not yet gone close to winning over trips at up to 1m2f.
comments.madameplaintiff: 7f winner; slipping to a handy mark and visor goes on; still a bit to prove.
comments.rainwater: 9.5f AW winner; has slipped to a handy mark and drops in grade for this; not ruled out.
comments.shahnaz: Won this last year (4lb lower); recent run may have helped and she's iikely to have a say.
comments.transfuse: 20-1 on handicap debut, when beaten more than 11l; drops 3lb; more needed.
comments.zebrastar: Dual 7f winner; beaten 3l from this basement mark back over 1m latest; more needed.

races.raceComment: shahnaz is marginally preferred with a score of 56.8%, holding clear edges in stronger recent form over ayrpoet. Won 2 of last 6 starts. Ground (Good) looks ideal with 3 wins from 16 starts in similar conditions, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.
